purpose: Wave-continue residual pack: high-value Desert + Fremennik permanent skilling unlocks still missing as first-class ids after desert-2026-07-26, fremennik-2026-07-26, and wave4 desert/frem fills. Targets Menaphos reputation engines (city quests, soul obelisks), Het residual infrastructure (Agility course, Statue of Het oasis XP, Blessing of Het relic), Lunar residual spells not micro-rowed (Magic Imbue, Repair Rune Pouch, Spin Flax), azure skillchompas (official Fremennik non-combat), and dragon pickaxe Chaos Battlefield pressure (Mining tool twin to existing DK hatchet). Skips re-rows of thick present hubs.

policy.region_rule: region_hint is primary geography. required_regions lists hard gates; optional_pressure_regions are support only. Never put multi-region/cross-region/global tokens in region_hint.
policy.duplicate_guard: Grep-confirmed ABSENT from data/research/regional-skilling-unlocks.json before write. SKIP present (not thin enough to re-emit): desert:menaphos-skilling-hub, desert:menaphos-reputation-vip, desert:menaphos-merchant-thieving, desert:menaphos-port-fish-cook, desert:menaphos-worker-mineral-deposits, desert:menaphos-imperial-acadia, desert:shifting-tombs (detail already covers camouflage 5x, soul talisman 1/200, feathers, tiers), desert:soul-altar, desert:hets-oasis-prayer-powders, desert:hets-oasis-farming, desert:powder-of-burials, desert:powder-of-penance, desert:dundee-crocodile-upgrades, desert:holy-scarab, desert:feather-of-maat-supply, desert:unexpected-diplomacy-relic, fremennik:lunar-spellbook, fremennik:lunar-isle-hub, fremennik:lunar-farming-utility, fremennik:livid-farm, fremennik:bake-pie, fremennik:telekinetic-grind, fremennik:npc-contact, fremennik:plank-make, fremennik:superglass-make, fremennik:humidify, fremennik:string-jewellery, fremennik:make-leather, fremennik:managing-miscellania (first-class; not missing), fremennik:dagannoth-kings-dragon-hatchet (DK skilling tool already filed — do not re-emit combat rings/staves), forinthry:pouch-protector-relic.
policy.thin_skip_rule: shifting-tombs and soul-altar live rows are not thin (wiki-grade unlock lists already ingested). Miscellania is first-class. Residual work only files buried engines and missing micro-unlocks.
policy.dagannoth_rule: Skilling-only: dragon hatchet already first-class. No berserker/seers/warrior/archers rings, mud battlestaff, or seercull. Dragon pickaxe is Chaos Dwarf Battlefield / Chaos Giants (Fremennik), not DKs — separate Mining tool residual.
policy.no_trade_rule: Ironman permanent unlocks that change reputation throughput, Prayer/RC supply, Lunar processing, gather tools, or oasis infrastructure.
policy.rate_rule: No invented XP/hour or drop rates beyond wiki structure. Unlock state, costs, effects, and region pressure only.
policy.combo_fields: Every multi-region row sets region_hints, required_regions, optional_pressure_regions, region_requirement_type, and links_existing_ids.

2,000 faction reputation per full completion plus small/medium/large Menaphite gift offerings
